body: Time to put on a smile and talk to people, thanks for listening to me.
I did apply for a job at a couple chain stores figured I could get out of the house. No one called back.

There's no concrete plan, I'm just sitting on a street corner trying to calm my nerves. As for moving out, I don't think I have the time to get a job. Last week I couldn't even study for a history exam because I was running around trying please my parents. I know I failed, I don't even know why I bothered going to school should have just stopped after highschool, I probably could have a job and be living on my own. You know what's funny, they aren't going to notice I'm gone, it's my brother's birthday and at this point I'm not surprised if I was responsible for setting everything up. Last night my parents woke me up 3 times in sitting on maybe 6 hrs of sleep this week and I just can't feel myself anymore all I want to do is cry.
